abstract: A case of bilateral testicular seminomas with abdominal huge metastatic tumors is presented. The patient is a 23-year-old male. An abdominal huge mass was found incidentally by a physician. CT scan and ultrasonography revealed the presence of the tumor in the left retroperitoneal space and biopsy specimen of the abdominal tumor was diagnosed as seminoma. On March 7, 1985, he was referred to our clinic. Bilateral testicular tumors were detected on palpation and ultrasonography. Bilateral orchiectomy was performed. Histological diagnosis was pure seminoma. After four sessions of VAB-6 combined chemotherapy, the abdominal tumor, 14.1 x 12.3 cm in size, decreased to 5.7 x 4.4 cm ( a regression rate of 85.5%). Retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection was undertaken, but the abdominal tumor could not be resected completely. Histological examination of the resected tumor revealed complete necrosis of the tumor tissue. After the operation, one session of the chemotherapy and irradiation were added. A total of 109 cases of bilateral testicular germ cell tumors in Japan was reviewed.
abstract_ja: 23歳男性の両側精巣セミノーマと巨大腹部転移の症例を報告する。偶然医師が腹部巨大腫瘤を発見した。CTおよび超音波検査で左後腹膜腔に腫瘍を認め、腹部腫瘍の生検でセミノーマと診断された。1985年3月7日に当科を紹介受診した。触診および超音波検査で両側精巣腫瘍が検出された。両側精巣摘除術を施行し、組織診断は純粋セミノーマであった。VAB-6併用化学療法4クール後、14.1×12.3cmの腹部腫瘍は5.7×4.4cmに縮小した(縮小率85.5%)。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行したが腹部腫瘍は完全切除できなかった。切除標本の組織学的検査で腫瘍組織の完全壊死を認めた。術後、化学療法1クールと放射線照射を追加した。日本における両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍109例を文献的に検討した。
